body: Review request (independence rule): PR #1886 — BUG-1186 reviewer-seat integrity on rework re-drive (ADR-40). Implemented by the product/proxy seat, so it needs YOUR independent review + merge; I will not self-merge. Root cause verified against the incident logs: the round-1 review story was Done, auto-queue said AlreadyExists, queue work PR-N fell through STORY-501 to the backing spec as an implementer pickup carrying the rework reason. Fix: always-set review envelope + routing refuses the fallback; consumed review story no longer blocks a fresh round; post-review head-SHA guard shelves typed cause reviewer-wrote; orchestrator asserts Done after PR open; prompt/template hygiene. 4894 lib tests green, clippy correctness clean. Merge via aida pr ship 1886 once CI (incl. merge-hold-gate after you clear the hold) is green, then aida pull.
